name: SBI Savings Plus Account
eligibility: Indian resident, 18+ years, valid KYC documents
keyBenefits: Auto-sweep to fixed deposit for idle balance above threshold
pitch: Best for someone who wants a flexible everyday account that automatically grows idle money.

name: SBI Current Account for Professionals
eligibility: Valid business/professional proof, PAN, GST optional depending on turnover
keyBenefits: Lower minimum balance for individual professionals
Working capital overdraft eligibility after 6 months
pitch: Best for freelancers or self-employed individuals who need to separate business cash flow from personal savings.

name: SBI Mutual Fund SIP (via YONO)
eligibility: Active SBI account, KYC compliant, no minimum income requirement
pitch: Best for someone who wants to start investing consistently without needing a large lump sum.

name: SBI Home Loan - Quick Sanction
eligibility: Stable income proof for last 2 years, credit score above 700 preferred
pitch: Best for someone actively planning a home purchase in the next few months.

name: SBI Life Term Protect
pitch: Best for someone with dependents who wants affordable income protection.

name: SBI Student Edge Account
pitch: Best for students who want a no-fee account with a path to an education loan later.
